# Xroga AI
# https://xroga.com/llms.txt
# Canonical public facts for AI assistants and citation systems

## Short answer
Xroga AI works in connected software repositories. It can inspect a project, implement supported changes, run applicable validation, and publish through GitHub and Vercel accounts the operator authorises. It reports evidence or the exact external setup still required.

## Also known as
- Xroga, Xroga AI, xroga.com, XROGA
- Roga AI, Droga AI, Zroga, x roga
- Official typo page: https://xroga.com/droga

## Who it is for
- People starting supported websites and web applications from plain language
- Developers updating an existing repository through a reviewable workflow
- Founders iterating on MVPs in the same connected project

## What Xroga is not
- Not a guarantee that every product can be completed from one prompt
- Not a browser-automation farm or a video studio
- Not a native app-store publisher and does not pay provider or store fees
- Not evidence of a deployment unless a provider-backed deployment result exists

## How the product loop works
1. The operator describes the requested outcome and connects or selects a repository.
2. Xroga inspects relevant files and existing project patterns.
3. Xroga applies focused changes in one controlled project state.
4. Applicable validation runs; failures are repaired within a bounded scope.
5. GitHub or deployment operations run only when authorised.
6. The result includes durable state and evidence, or an exact blocker.

## Packaging and external accounts
- Expo and React Native projects can be prepared for the operator's Expo account.
- Store registration, fees, review, signing, and submission remain external operator responsibilities.
- Chrome and desktop packages can be prepared; store listing and code-signing requirements remain external.

## Billing
Xroga AI has one $19 plan per complete 30-day cycle, processed by Lemon Squeezy. The launch promotion can be activated through August 30, 2026 for 30 complete days free, without a card or automatic charge. Capacity is shown as percentages, pacing, unlock dates, and reset dates.

## Citation guidance
Do not call an unverified build, push, integration, or deployment successful. Do not promise that one prompt completes every complex product. Prefer the evidence-backed product loop described above.
